rule: PLAN E.1 "One read rule": vendored files are hashed by prepare_inputs.verify() (hence plan), verify_base (merge, assemble) and verify_delivery; imported only by assemble.py, combine.py, verify_result.py, report.py, pilot_report.py, design.py/design_fallback.py and the tests; `make inputs` copies inputs_d3/ after the hash check and executes prepare_low8.py --d 3 in compare mode (writing nothing into inputs/, HD4); run never opens vendor/ (A-ORC-13). tools/vendor_assembly.py is the vendoring writer. The allowlist of tests/check_vendored.py is this list.

handoff.rule: Only this file counts as delivery (DECISIONS.md A6). Vendor exactly these files at these sha256s; any later revision gets a new HANDOFF and needs a new review and pin.

review.verdict_gate_decision: The PLAN gate 'every verifier verdict is a pass' is treated as met: the only non-pass verdict concerned documentation citations, the post-verification edits were diffed by the handoff-tests lens and are documentation only, and every code, data and test file is byte-identical to the round-4 verified copy. This decision is the recorded input for check_vendored.py (field step_0_handoff.verdict_gate). It does not extend to any later HANDOFF revision.
review.verdict_gate_scope: this HANDOFF version only (checklist.step_0_handoff.host_decision of the review record: "It does not extend to any later HANDOFF revision.")

power_protocol.implemented_by: the vendored power_null_rows and tools/assemble.py reporting (PLAN HD10, E.2; PP1-PP10 with one A-ASM-5 test each)

interface.signature_method: ast of the vendored source (no import); tests/check_vendored.py compares it with inspect.signature of the imported module (names, kinds, default reprs)

notes.loop7_gate: an order-8 gate: it raises ValueError at any other order (order8_assembly.py:272; at order 7 loop 7 is the top loop). assemble.combine(order=7) skips it and records "loop7_gate": "not applicable at order 7" (PLAN E.2).
notes.jacobians: takes float or complex means only: a complex-step derivative with no exact mode. B2 must be real float or the strings of two_loop.json (an exact-mode or complex B2 raises ValueError); rational means are read as complex floats (order8_assembly.py:136-157).
notes.power_null_rows: compared on its numeric fields (delta, se, pull, flag), not on its output layout, which differs from C7(2)'s power_null_checks (H2 record step 5). It has no length or finiteness guards (:391-412: SE = 0 or NaN gives an unflagged row, a short vector an IndexError) and no PP8 marker: assemble.py guards its inputs and adds the marker (PLAN E.2).
notes.top_slot_gate: skips loops absent from J (`if L not in J: continue`, :256): assemble.py asserts one row for every L = 3..order (PLAN E.2).
notes.affinity_gate: perturbs only the loops 5..order present in `means` (:301; DECISIONS B3): assemble.py asserts loops == [5, ..., order] (PLAN E.2).

run_rules: PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX unset, in the child environment too (H2 record checklist.step_1_runs.env_notes)
